formal_statement.basis: If X has full column rank and both maps are independently justified affine maps on the same coordinates, X*d=0 implies d=0. Finite matches do not establish affine class membership.
formal_statement.finite_precision_scope: Component radii depend on the declared measurement model; empirical 1e-12 allowances are not universal bounds on upstream arithmetic.

research_design_audit.training_split: N/A: no training, learned inference or fitted preprocessing. References come from independently parsed source metadata and explicit runtime formulas, not deployment responses.
research_design_audit.selection_and_leakage: Metadata and injection recipes were inspected before committed acquisition; selected native outcomes were unseen at selected revisions, not blinded/ancestry-disjoint/unseen root causes.
research_design_audit.duplicates_and_independence: Canonical/manual endpoints overlap, PI transport shares same artifact, random seeds/interventions/queries are repeated measures, artifacts share base/corpus ancestry, clean runs repeat same inputs. No independent sample count is inferred.
research_design_audit.baselines: Equal canonical query/reference access for three numerical oracles; all 8 geometries get 2n+1 native queries. Native workflows keep their distinct scopes. Unavailable rollout/physical/response workflows receive no scored wins/misses.
research_design_audit.statistics: Finite counts and descriptive equal-artifact-weight leave-one-out sensitivity only; no population CI, p-values, multiple-testing or accuracy generalization claims.
research_design_audit.effect_size: Large declared offset/width injections; no empirical sensitivity curve for naturally occurring small drift. Witness/cost findings are negative for superiority; human effort unmeasured.
research_design_audit.scientific_scope: Engineering/reproducible evidence-comparison contribution; no new affine theorem or new policy/safety discovery asserted.
research_design_audit.reviewer_kind: AI-assisted technical review; no independent human peer review or human-author attestation.

literature_audit.scope: Focused primary-source audit, not systematic/exhaustive. Principal citations previously verified against author/publisher/arXiv sources; immutable versions retained; Zeller/Bauer DOIs added.
